SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - FEBRUARY 27, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
Staff Report
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
Staff Report
4.
Roll Call
Council/Agency Member Bruce W. Barrows
Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.
Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Jim Edwards
Mayor/Chair Carol Chen
5.
Presentations
PLEASE NOTE: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the City Clerk’s Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
This meeting is being held in lieu of the regularly scheduled meeting of February 24, 2012 which was canceled.
Staff Report
6.
Consideration of appointments to vacancies on various commissions, boards and committees
Staff Report
7.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Those wishing to present comments on other than Agenda items are requested to complete and submit a blue Speaker’s Card. The Public Comments and Suggestions portion of the meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
CONSENT CALENDAR*
Items 8, 9, 10 and 11 under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
8.
Approval of Register of Demands
8A.
City of Cerritos dated February 27, 2012. (COUNCIL)
9.
Approval of Treasurer’s Report for the period ending December 31, 2011
(COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
10.
Approval of Minutes
10A.
City Council Regular Meeting of February 9, 2012.
(COUNCIL)
10B.
Successor Agency Regular Meeting of February 9, 2012.
(SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
11.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1123-12, Supply of Polyorthophosphate in Drum.
(COUNCIL)
Staff Report
End of Consent Calendar
If you would like to speak on any of the remaining Agenda items, please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. Speakers will be called upon for comment after the report on the item is given by City staff.
12.
Public Hearings
Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker’s Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public hearing.
12A.
A development proposal by property owner Cerritos Baptist Church of Cerritos California, Inc., for an exterior and interior remodel of the existing fellowship hall/classroom building and construction of a first and second-floor addition to accommodate an elevator and additional storage at 11947 Del Amo Boulevard, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned single-family residential (RS-6500) (APN 7055-014-046).
(COUNCIL)
Precise Plan 74-10(B)(2012) Amendment
Pursuant to section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
Staff Report
12B.
A proposal by property owner McKenna Cerritos, LP, 23147 Ventura Boulevard, Suite 100, Woodland Hills, CA, for a showroom addition as well as an interior and exterior remodel to the existing McKenna Volkswagen Dealership building located at 18303 Studebaker Road, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned Development Area Five (ADP-5) and is located in the Los Cerritos Development Project Area (APN 7038-011-019).
(COUNCIL)
Precise Plan 86-4(C)(2012) Amendment
Pursuant to section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
Staff Report
13.

13A.

(COUNCIL)
Staff Report
14.

(COUNCIL)
Staff Report

Consideration and adoption of the Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS) of the City of Cerritos, as Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency, to conform with Health and Safety Code Sections 34167(h) and 34169(g), in compliance with Assembly Bill 1X 26.
(SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO ADOPT A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) TO FORMALIZE THE SISTER CITY RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE CITY OF NEW TAIPEI CITY, (FORMERLY BANCIAO), TAIWAN AND THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.
(COUNCIL)
Staff Report
15.

15A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
15B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
16.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
17.
Adjournment
